# sfcompute_firewall (Resource)

Manages an SF Compute firewall (created with `POST /preview/v2/firewalls`, updated in place with `PUT /preview/v2/firewalls/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sfcompute_firewall" "ssh_and_https" {
  name = "ssh-and-https"
  rules = [
    { direction = "ingress", protocol = "tcp", port = "22", source = "203.0.113.0/24" },
    # source defaults to 0.0.0.0/0.
    { direction = "ingress", protocol = "tcp", port = "443" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `rules` (Attributes List) Allow-only ingress rules. Order is preserved across reads and PUT replacements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Workspace to create this firewall in. If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) Firewall ID or resource path
- `owner` (String)
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a firewall resource. Format: sfc:firewall:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `workspace_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `direction` (String) Direction of a firewall rule. Only `ingress` is accepted today; `egress` is reserved for future use and rejected with 422 if submitted.
- `protocol` (String)

Optional:

- `port` (String) Required for tcp/udp; must be absent on icmp.
- `source` (String) IPv4 source CIDR. Defaults to `0.0.0.0/0` (allow from any address) when omitted on input. Cannot overlap non-publicly-routable space (private, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, documentation, multicast, etc.); the wildcard `0.0.0.0/0` is the only exception.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sfcompute_firewall.ssh_and_https frwl_k3RnX9vLm7Qp2Yw5Jd8F
```
